events.name: M8 Alpha
events.text: I have never let accuracy limit my ambition.

events.name: M8 Bravo
events.text: I saved a front-row seat in your crater.

events.name: M8 Charlie
events.text: I am about to update your location in place.

events.name: M8 Alpha
events.text: Please face the camera and the shell.

events.name: M8 Bravo
events.text: I was not prepared for this much earth.

events.name: M8 Charlie
events.text: The prop department has made an error.

events.name: M8 Alpha
events.text: I have sacrificed accuracy for dramatic effect.

events.name: M8 Charlie
events.text: This meeting could have been an explosion.

events.name: M8 Alpha
events.text: Your subscription to quiet has expired.

events.name: M8 Charlie
events.text: The safety check returned a nervous laugh.
